title: ChainedHearts
description: A plugin that connects damage, hunger and potion effects between players
body:
❤️ **Chained Hearts** ❤️

Chained Hearts is the first plugin of its kind for Minecraft Java Edition, connecting players in a completely new way.

Plugin Features:
* Shared Damage — when one player takes damage, all linked players take it too
* Shared Hunger — hunger is synchronized between all linked players
* Shared Effects — potion effects are applied to every linked player
* Option to enable/disable Action Bar messages
* Most plugin messages can be easily customized
* UPDATE: Turn on/off one heart for all

This plugin is perfect for challenge videos, survival series, or playing with friends.

You can set everything in the menu that you open with the command:
```
/chainedhearts settings
```
